page_title: LIL 4-1 ETI | Lille v St Etienne 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+5' Alexsandro (Lille) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
90+4' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) will take the corner.
90+4' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
90+4' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' OFF THE WOODWORK! Osame Sahraoui (Lille) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!

90+1' Jonathan David (Lille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Gautier Larsonneur is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
89' Younes Lachaab (Lille) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
87' Here comes a substitution. Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) is brought on as a substitute for Zuriko Davitashvili.
85' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
84' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Younes Lachaab (Lille) replacing Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
81' A long through ball into the box almost gives Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
78' 4 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Osame Sahraoui (Lille) was set free in the area by Mitchel Bakker and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Mitchel Bakker (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriel Gudmundsson.
73' Eirik Horneland has decided to make a change. Yvann Macon (St Etienne) replaces Louis Mouton.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pierre Cornud (St Etienne) is coming onto the pitch as Leo Petrot cannot continue after picking up an injury.

72' 3 - 1 Hakon Arnar Haraldsson passes the ball into the penalty area. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 3:1!
69' Andre Gomes (Lille) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Gautier Larsonneur and he's equal to it.

68' Lille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
64' Remy Cabella will be replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).

63' 2 - 1 GOAL! Jonathan David finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Osame Sahraoui (Lille), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 2:1.
62' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
61' Remy Cabella (Lille) tested Gautier Larsonneur with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
57' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
56' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
53' Close! Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
51' Substitution. Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) in, Lucas Stassin out.
50' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
50' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
48' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
46' Eirik Horneland has made a change at the break. Augustine Boakye has come on in place of Irvin Cardona (St Etienne).
46' Bruno Genesio makes a switch. Osame Sahraoui is coming on in place of Angel Gomes (Lille) at the start of the second period.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Bruno Genesio probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Aissa Mandi (Lille). He is replaced by Thomas Meunier.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Lille! Play can continue.

45+4' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lille players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
45+3' Alexsandro (Lille) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
45+3' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45+2' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Lille.

45+1' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Gautier Larsonneur is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' The referee blows his whistle after Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
42' Jonathan David (Lille) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
41' Looks like Angel Gomes (Lille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

37' Jonathan David (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
37' Remy Cabella (Lille) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
36' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

36' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Gautier Larsonneur makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
36' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) works the corner short.
35' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Lucas Stassin (St Etienne), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
32' 1 - 1 Jonathan David (Lille) sends Gautier Larsonneur the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
32' Jonathan David (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
31' The Lille players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
31' Referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lille. Let’s see what happens!
30' PENALTY APPEAL after Jonathan David (Lille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
28' A cross into the box picks out Louis Mouton (St Etienne), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
27' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Alexsandro (Lille) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
25' The referee awards a corner and Remy Cabella (Lille) goes over to take it.

24' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Remy Cabella (Lille) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
23' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar.
19' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar.
14' Wonderful movement by Lille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
12' Flag up against Jonathan David (Lille). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) brings an opponent down and Eric Wattellier interrupts the game.

8' What a chance that is! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!
6' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Lucas Chevalier no chance!
6' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
4' Remy Cabella (Lille) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to St Etienne!
3' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. St Etienne will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
